author: Linnaeus, 1758
status: 나그네새 10만 마리 이상 · 여름철새 수만 마리 · 겨울에도 드물게 기록
summary: 전국의 농경지와 하천에서 흔히 볼 수 있는 여름철새이다. 트인 곳을 빠르게 날며 곤충을 잡고, 쉴 때는 주로 전깃줄에 앉는다. 시골이나 도시 가까운 집과 건물의 안팎, 다리 따위에 흙과 지푸라기를 섞어 둥지를 짓고 묵은 둥지를 다시 쓰기도 하며, 흰 바탕에 적갈색과 엷은 자색 잔점이 흩어진 알을 5~6개 낳는다. 새끼는 부화하고 20~24일쯤 지나 둥지를 떠나며, 국외에서는 유럽, 아시아, 북미 전역에 분포한다.

art.subject: Barn Swallow (Hirundo rustica), adult male in summer: forehead and throat deep chestnut-red; crown, nape, back, rump and wing coverts glossy dark steel-blue; a narrow blue-black band across the upper breast below the red throat; rest of the underparts white with a faint pale buff to pale orange wash; underwing coverts whitish; flight feathers blackish; tail glossy blue-black and deeply forked, with long thin outer streamers and a row of white spots across the inner webs; tiny black bill with a wide gape; dark eye; short black legs.
art.pose: perched on an overhead wire, resting
art.scene: Korean summer farmland with rice paddies and a stream, a wire strung across the fields; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male, perched on a wire, side view: chestnut-red forehead and throat, narrow dark breast band, glossy steel-blue upperparts, pale buff-washed white belly, long outer tail streamers reaching well beyond the wingtips
adult female, perched on a wire, side view: the same colours, but the outer tail streamers noticeably shorter, extending only a little beyond the wingtips

adult in flight seen from below, head, body and tail in line, tail spread: red throat, dark breast band, whitish belly and underwing coverts, dark flight feathers, deep V-shaped fork with white spots across the tail
art.build: Slender swallow, about 18cm including the tail streamers; the body is smaller than a House Sparrow's. Flat head, very short neck, streamlined body. Bill tiny, flat and triangular, black, with a very wide gape. Legs very short, black, used only for perching. Wings long, narrow and pointed; at rest the wingtips fall short of the tail streamers. Tail deeply forked, the outer feathers drawn out into long streamers, longer in the male. Flight fast and swooping, low over fields and water.
avoid: Do not paint a rufous rump or a rufous neck collar with streaked underparts; that is Red-rumped Swallow.
Do not paint a white rump and a short shallow fork; that is Asian House Martin.
Do not paint deep chestnut underparts; Korean birds are white below with at most a pale buff wash.
Do not spread the red onto the breast; the red is confined to the forehead and throat above the dark band.
